responsibility: This file provides the target-independent core algorithms and utilities shared by GCC command-line option parsing code in both the driver and compiler proper. It implements low-level lookup and decoding support over the generated cl_options/cl_enums tables—most notably the back-chain-aware find_opt matcher for exact, joined-argument, and abbreviated long options—along with helpers for querying and snapshotting option state, applying warning-option state changes such as -Werror=/pragma diagnostic through control_warning_option, and parsing or reconstructing quoted COLLECT_GCC_OPTIONS / assembler option strings used when propagating options between compilation stages.
